edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource; the variant readings it marks are left out, and the 將 it supplies in brackets in 將進酒，杯莫停 is printed without them. Lines broken at the punctuation for reading; text unchanged.
edition.zh: 据维基文库，删去其所注异文；“将进酒，杯莫停”句中原以括号补出的“将”字径直排入。按标点分行，文字未改。

basis.en: Tang dynasty poem; the author died in 762.

note.en: A drinking song in an old yuefu form, written around 752 with two friends, Cen Xun and Yuan Danqiu, whom it names. It swings between grandeur and despair inside single lines: the river from heaven, white hair by evening, gifts that 'must have their use'. Read it aloud; the long and short lines are built for a voice, and the last phrase turns the whole party into a toast against a sorrow older than everyone in the room.
note.zh: 一首沿用乐府旧题的劝酒歌，约 752 年与岑勋、元丹丘两位朋友同饮时作，诗中直呼其名。它常在一句之内就从豪迈跌到悲凉：黄河天上来，朝如青丝暮成雪，天生我材必有用。请大声读它；长短句是为嗓音而造的，最后一句把整场酒会变成一次举杯，对抗比在座所有人都古老的愁。

excerpt.orig: 君不見，黃河之水天上來，奔流到海不復回！
excerpt.en: Have you not seen / the Yellow River's waters coming down from heaven, / rushing to the sea, never to return?
excerpt.zh: 君不见，黄河之水天上来，奔流到海不复回！

gloss.en: Cen Xun, a friend of Li Bai; 夫子 is a respectful 'master'.
gloss.zh: 岑夫子：岑勋，李白的朋友。夫子，尊称。

gloss.en: Yuan Danqiu, a Daoist and Li Bai's close friend.
gloss.zh: 丹丘生：元丹丘，道士，李白的好友。

gloss.en: 將, read qiāng: please. 'Please, drink.' It is also the title, an old yuefu tune.
gloss.zh: 将（qiāng）：请。将进酒，请喝酒。也是乐府旧题。

gloss.en: Food as fine as jade: rich banquets.
Cao Zhi, Prince of Chen, whose poem describes a feast at Pingle Lodge in Luoyang with wine at ten thousand cash a dou.
gloss.zh: 陈王：曹植，封陈王。其《名都篇》有“归来宴平乐，美酒斗十千”。平乐：平乐观，在洛阳。

gloss.en: A dappled horse; some say a horse with its mane clipped into five tufts. Either way, a prized mount.
gloss.zh: 五花马：毛色斑驳的名马；一说马鬃剪成五瓣。
